get.description:
Retrieve the list of identifying information for discovered devices. 

The number and set of devices returned can be filtered by using the query parameters. It is suggested to limit the use of the query parameters to the following combinations:
- `first`
- `first` & `after`
- `last`
- `last` & `before`

If more than 1,000 devices are discovered, clients must send successive requests to obtain all devices.

200.description: The specified devices' properties were returned successfully.

post.description:
Subscribe to changes in the state of *all* discovered Shure devices.

This subscription is a **transition stream** — it emits events only when a device's state changes. Events are emitted when:
- A new device is discovered on your network (Server)
- A discovered device disappears from your network (Server)
- A claimed device goes offline (Cloud)
- A claimed device comes online (Cloud)

> When a device state is changed the resulting event message delivered over the configured subscription transport will include the full suite of properties that make up the device model.

> Unlike per-device / per-feature subscriptions (for example `subscribeDeviceName`, `subscribeDeviceAudioMute`), this endpoint does **not** emit an initial snapshot of the current inventory when the subscription is created — it only forwards subsequent transitions. Applications must call `GET /v1/devices` once at startup, and again after every WebSocket transport rotation, to learn about devices that already exist in the organization's inventory. See the [Cloud Getting Started guide](../docs/Cloud-Getting-Started.md#quotas--rate-limits) for the recommended hydrate-then-subscribe pattern.

Events emitted: [`DeviceStateChangeEvent`](API/system-api-server.json/components/schemas/DeviceStateChangeEvent)

shure-device-keyring.description:
See Getting Started guide for details.

 Custom HTTP header token to be passed for endpoints which require operations to be performed on devices which has authentication enabled.

 Include the token in a header parameter called `shure-device-keyring`.

 Example: `shure-device-keyring: 123`

first.name: first
first.description:
Limit the number of records to return starting from the beginning of the data. 

 The actual number of records returned may be less depending on 

 - Other query parameters 
 - The remaining data on the server 
 - The integrity of the data on the server (e.g is all required data for the record able to be returned). The default value for this limit is 1000.

last.name: last
last.description:
Limit the number of records to return starting from the end of the data.  

 The actual number of records returned may be less depending on 

 - Other query parameters 
 - The remaining data on the server 
 - The integrity of the data on the server (e.g is all required data for the record able to be returned)

before.name: before
before.description: A url-encoded cursor value used by the server to filter the results. Only records with a cursor lexically less than the value of `before` will be returned.

after.name: after
after.description: A url-encoded cursor value used by the server to filter the results. Only records with a cursor lexically greater than the value of `after` will be returned.
